literal: Having striven, having guarded, let one protect decorum; having examined, having guarded, even if researched, that indeed is the support.
translation: Strive hard and guard your good conduct. Even if you examine and carefully research all other virtues, good conduct alone is your true support.
modern: வருந்தியும் போற்றியும் நல்லொழுக்கத்தைக் காக்க வேண்டும்; பல அறங்களை ஆராய்ந்து போற்றித் தெளிந்தாலும், அந்த நல்லொழுக்கமே ஒருவனுக்குச் சிறந்த துணையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the supreme importance of good conduct or decorum ('ஒழுக்கம்'). The word 'பரிந்து' implies that one must protect their character even if it requires great effort or hardship. The second line states that even if one examines and practices many other virtues ('தெரிந்து ஓம்பி தேரினும்'), good conduct remains the ultimate and most reliable support ('அஃதே துணை') in life. The repetition of 'ஓம்பி' (having guarded) underscores the constant vigilance needed to maintain one's moral integrity.
